ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: CDS C1 residency table (fall 2025): applicants 6,171 in-state / 1,018 out-of-state / 167 international (7,356 total); admits 5,110 / 851 / 57 (6,018); enrolled 885 / 119 / 10 (1,014). International applicants were admitted at a much lower rate than the total (57 of 167). The CDS sex-split rows of C1 show only 6,171 applicants and 5,110 admits, so the residency table totals are used. Undergraduate enrollment 4,289 is the CDS B1 'Total all undergraduates' (fall 2025); 14:1 ratio is CDS I-2. Winthrop reports a high school GPA average of 3.99 (C12) and a GPA distribution whose alignment could not be read reliably, so GPA fields are omitted. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-year students (C9). The CDS checkboxes in C7 contradict C8A (test scores marked very important yet not used), so the factors are omitted.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8F: 'We are test-optional for 2026-27 academic year. Decision has not been made for Fall 2027 admits.' C8A also marks SAT/ACT as not considered for admission.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2025-26): in-state tuition $11,130, out-of-state $25,170, required fees $3,550, on-campus food and housing $14,112; G5 books $1,200, transportation $2,702 and other expenses $4,168 for residents. H6: 61 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid (avg $24,492; total $1,494,033); the need-based versus non-need-based checkbox could not be read.
